name: Nuclear Reactors

pages.title: Nuclear Reactors
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() The reactor outputs ordinary rotation through a shaft
- Fuel: uranium to Yellowcake, enriched, then made into Uranium Rods
- It needs fuel rods, cooling rods, and water or liquid nitrogen
- Too hot with too little cooling and it **melts down and explodes**

Create Nuclear adds uranium, thorium, a [#](7A3C9A)[multiblock](entry://glossary/multiblock)[#]() reactor and radiation. The reactor outputs ordinary rotation through a shaft, so it plugs into any [#](7A3C9A)[Create network](entry://glossary/kinetic_network)[#](). It is also the pack's source of lead.

pages.title: Uranium chain
pages.text: [#](2E5AAC)[Crush](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() raw uranium to powder, [#](7A3C9A)[mix](entry://glossary/mixing)[#]() it into liquid, [#](7A3C9A)[compact](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() that to Yellowcake. Thorium follows a similar route. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

pages.title: Enriching Campfire
pages.text: Its green Enriching Fire, blown through by a [#](2E5AAC)[fan](entry://create_basics/fans)[#](), turns Yellowcake into Enriched Yellowcake. Make it from Enriched Soul Soil.

pages.title: Fuel rods
pages.text: Enriched Yellowcake pressed in a Mechanical Crafter makes Uranium Rods (fuel). Graphite Rods, from graphene and steel, are the cooling rods.

**Reactor build:** Reactor Casing (a Brass Casing plus steel) forms a T1, T2 or T3 tower following the pattern in Ponder.\
\
Place the Controller, then a Rod Input, Fluid Input, Output and an optional Alarm in casing spots.

pages.title: Reactor Controller
pages.text: Right-click it with a filled [Reactor Blueprint](item://createnuclear:reactor_blueprint_item) to start. You need fuel and cooling rods, plus water or liquid nitrogen in the Fluid Input.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** too hot with too little cooling and the reactor melts down and explodes. Put an Alarm nearby.\
\
Two Rod Inputs are needed: one for heating rods, one for cooling. Drive a shaft off the Reactor Output for rotation.

pages.title: Radiation
pages.text: Radiation hurts, and irradiated mobs exist. Anti Radiation armor protects. It can be dyed with cloth.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Steel here is made by mixing coal dust and an iron ingot in a [#](2E5AAC)[heated mixer](entry://create_basics/heat)[#](), and it gives TFMG steel. The reactor accepts any steel (see [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]()).\
\
Create Nuclear's lead is the pack's only lead. Rotation to FE: [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation vs Electricity](entry://industry/power_compared)[#]().
